changes: Upload files to the printer from the UI (CC1, CC2, Klipper/Moonraker, Prusa/PrusaLink) — CC2 uses the same chunked upload as ElegooSlicer and is not yet confirmed on real hardware
Report bug button in the footer — pick the printer, describe the issue, and open a prefilled GitHub issue with redacted diagnostics (IPs, serials, names and access codes removed)
CC2: poll the full status instead of machine status only
Secrets at rest are now protected with locked-down file permissions
Notifications: send to ntfy, Telegram, Discord or any webhook as well as browser push (set up and switched on or off under Settings → Notifications, each with a Send test button)

New notification events: print started, paused, error (with the cause and code), filament runout, and printer offline / back online; completion, start, pause, error and runout notices can include a camera picture

CC2: error codes now shown with a readable cause (about 33 codes from Elegoo's own firmware source: heaters, fans, sensors, Canvas filament feed, cutter and more), including a suggested fix where Elegoo names one; faults are read from the printer's exception list, and command replies like "printer busy" are no longer mistaken for faults
CC2: the status badge now says what the printer is doing while it prepares (Heating nozzle/bed, Homing, Leveling, Loading/Unloading filament, Self-check) instead of just "Preparing"

CC1: self-check, leveling, resonance test, PID calibration, filament unloading and file checks outside a print are now shown (with the same activity labels as CC2) instead of looking idle, and the newer status codes Elegoo uses are recognised

CC1: if the printer rejects Start/Pause/Stop/Resume (busy, file not found, file check failed, wrong model), Spooler now tells you why instead of staying silent; a CC1 print that stops with an error points you to the printer's screen
CC1: a clear message when the printer refuses the connection because all 5 of its connection slots are in use

A camera picture is saved with each finished, cancelled or failed print and shown as a thumbnail in the print history (click for full size); it can be switched off under Settings → Features, and old pictures are removed together with their history entries
Optional per printer (Settings → Printers → edit, Centauri Carbon only): the light turns on when a print starts and off when it ends, after the end-of-print picture has been taken

API access (Settings → API access, off by default): other programs can use an API key to read the print history, pictures and statistics and change reference numbers; keys are shown once, stored hashed, and open only this API (see docs/external-api.md)

New Stats & history page (Stats in the side menu, replaces History): an Overview tab with prints, success rate, print time and filament for 7 days, 30 days, 12 months, all time or a custom period (per printer if you like) with a chart per day/week/month, filament by material, results and why prints stopped, and a Prints tab where you can search and open any print to see its picture, result and cause, times, filament, material, spools, pauses, and give it a reference number; CSV export includes the reference (Settings → Features → Statistics)

Filament use is now written to a ledger before it is sent to Spoolman and retried until Spoolman takes it (it is never counted twice): Spoolman being down, a restart in the middle of a print, a printer counter that resets, or a spool change no longer loses or doubles filament. Deductions that did not go through are listed under Spools with Try again / Discard, with a badge on the Spools button when something needs you
A warning ("Login is off" in the footer and on the Features page) is shown for as long as login is switched off (AUTH_ENABLED=false); features that act on the printers cannot be used then

Firmware versions are shown on every printer card (Centauri Carbon, Klipper, Prusa); a small yellow "untested firmware" notice appears for versions not in the tested list, and a firmware change is logged and can be notified (Settings → Notifications → Firmware changed)

Fixed: "Last updated" and the dimming of stale data now use the server's clock, so a phone or PC with the wrong time no longer makes fresh data look old; renaming a printer or changing its address no longer counts as hearing from it
Printer cards show the current layer (e.g. "Layer 25 / 120") next to the elapsed and remaining time
CC2: emergency stop, power-loss recovery, filament loading/unloading, leveling, homing and self-checks outside a print are now shown instead of looking idle
Web Push contact address is now configurable (VAPID_CONTACT) instead of hardcoded
Filament catalogue import moved from the Spools panel to Settings → Integrations, now with a brand dropdown so you can import any brand from SpoolmanDB (Elegoo preselected)
Backup and restore — download a backup, restore from a backup file, automatic daily and pre-upgrade safety backups with a configurable interval (Settings → Backup)
Settings → Features — toggle Camera, Backup, Notifications, Spoolman and Web Push on/off; disabled features are also hidden from the relevant Settings pages
Settings → Advanced → Integrations — configure the Spoolman URL and an optional Slicer link from the UI with no restart needed; optional Spoolman basic-auth for reverse-proxied setups
Print cards now show an estimated finish time (e.g. 'Done ~14:35', 'Done tomorrow 06:10'), hidden while paused in favor of a note that it'll update once the print resumes
Connection-loss banner with automatic reconnect and full state refresh when the browser loses its connection to Spooler; printer cards show 'last updated Xs/m/h ago' and dim when data is stale
Status indicator redesigned to read the printer's normalized state directly so the dot and badge can no longer disagree; shows the printer's error code when known
Printer cards show why a print paused, stopped, or errored when that information is available (e.g. triggered from Spooler vs. by the printer itself)
CC2 now shows firmware version and model under the printer name, like CC1 already did
CC2: more accurate status during homing, auto-leveling and bed-preheating phases; known error codes (e.g. leveling failure) now show a readable message instead of just a number
CC2: shows 'Camera not connected on printer' when the printer itself reports no camera module, instead of a generic connection failure
Fixed camera feed not resuming after the app was backgrounded for a while on mobile/PWA — now reconnects automatically when you return to the app
Fixed CC2 light control after a firmware update started requiring both brightness and power parameters

Printer card polish — readable 'no spool' text in Canvas slots, full spool name shown on linked trays, accessible light-on/off button with a clearer style, a 'light off' overlay with one-tap toggle over a dark camera feed, cards use the available width better

Fixed print-history bugs: completion occasionally missed when only detected via polling instead of a push update, a race condition that could corrupt history.json under concurrent writes, and filament-usage tracking incorrectly resetting on every pause/resume cycle
Expanded automated test suite (174 tests) and CI pipeline gating releases
Experimental Prusa support (PrusaLink HTTP API) — monitor status and temperatures, browse and start files, pause, resume and stop prints; requires API key from PrusaLink settings

Experimental Klipper support (Moonraker HTTP API) — same controls as Prusa; polls /printer/objects/query every 2 seconds, filament tracked live from print_stats.filament_used, remaining time estimated from file metadata; API key optional
Print speed slider for CC1 — adjust speed while printing or paused via SDCP Cmd 403 / PrintSpeedPct (protocol reference: centauri-carbon-dashboard open source project)
CC1 connection stability — disabled WebSocket-level pings (firmware ignores them causing spurious disconnects), replaced with 20-second CMD_STATUS keepalive
Push notification auto-renewal — pushsubscriptionchange service worker handler, startup subscription check, and VAPID public key no longer requires auth so renewals work without a session cookie

CC2 print options modal — print time, layer count and filament weight from MQTT method 1046; bed leveling, timelapse and plate options now shown for CC2 (protocol reference: danielcherubini/elegoo-homeassistant, ELEGOO-3D/elegoo-link)
Configurable WebSocket ports via WS_PORT/WSS_PORT environment variables (contributed by snazy2000)
Per-spool filament deduction for multi-material prints — filament tracked per tray and deducted from the correct spool on tray change (contributed by snazy2000)
Spoolman UI proxy improvements — SPA sub-route refresh support and better asset routing (contributed by snazy2000)
PROXY_SPOOLMAN env option — set to false to redirect the browser directly to Spoolman instead of proxying through Spooler, for better WebSocket support (contributed by snazy2000)
Spoolman location set to printer name automatically — spool location in Spoolman is updated to the printer's display name (e.g. 'CC2') on connect and on tray link, no manual setup needed
Canvas/AMS spools re-synced to Spoolman on every printer connect — location survives Spooler restarts without relinking
Fixed spool assign button hidden on CC1 without AMS — empty canvas response no longer suppresses the assign UI
Canvas AMS slots always on one line — all 4 slots share the row width equally on mobile
File browser redesigned — filename on its own line, Print and Delete buttons always visible without horizontal scrolling
Themed scrollbar styling — replaces white OS default scrollbar across all panels
Fixed CC2 filament tracking — fetches expected grams from file metadata at print start; live display tracks time-progress, history deducts the correct amount
Fixed CC2 progress bar stuck at 100% and missing remaining time — estimated from file's expected print duration since CC2 does not report remaining time via MQTT
Print speed slider for CC2 — adjust speed factor while printing or paused
Dynamic camera URL for CC2 — fetched via MQTT on connect instead of hardcoded
Delete file button in the file browser (CC1 and CC2)
Spool almost empty push notification — configurable gram threshold in Notification settings
Light mode toggle in Settings
CC2 print-complete notification now fires reliably (CC2 goes directly to standby, not 'complete' state)
Fixed push notification errors after modular backend refactor
Fixed CC1 print time display (CurrentTicks/TotalTicks normalisation, contributed by snazy2000)
Fixed fractional seconds showing in time display (contributed by snazy2000)
Print options modal before starting a print — thumbnail preview, build plate, time-lapse and bed levelling (contributed by snazy2000)
CC1 file list now shows estimated print time, layer count and filament usage (contributed by snazy2000)
Fixed camera placeholder not showing when printer is offline (contributed by snazy2000)
Printers sub-page in Settings — add, edit and remove printers without leaving the settings modal
Edit and delete buttons removed from printer cards (managed via Settings → Printers)
Print speed slider for CC1 — adjust speed factor while printing or paused (Cmd 403 / PrintSpeedPct)
CC2 print options modal — thumbnail preview via MQTT (method 1045), print time, layers and filament from file metadata (method 1046), bed leveling and plate options now shown for CC2
Modular backend: server split into auth, state, persistence, discovery, spoolman, ws_handler, http_handler and printers modules (contributed by snazy2000)
AMS/Canvas multi-material hub support — active tray auto-assigns linked spool (contributed by snazy2000)
WSS WebSocket on port 8766 so PWA and HTTPS users get a proper secure connection
Web Push notifications: print complete, layer checkpoint, nozzle still hot, nozzle overheat
Settings modal with Change Password and Notifications subpages
Discover and Add Printer moved to header; removed + button from sidenav
Fixed CC2 status stuck on 'printing' after print completes
Fixed auth-status API returning 500 for unauthenticated requests
Camera stream excluded from service worker fetch interception (fixes MJPEG on iOS PWA)
Replaced gear icon on printer cards with pencil/edit icon
Added Settings gear to sidenav with change-password modal
Moved Sign out to bottom of sidenav, removed from header
Fixed CC2 status showing 'printing' after print completes
Fixed CC2 light button not reflecting state after click
Fixed CC2 print progress showing over 100% (layer count used as percentage)
Fixed CC2 filament usage stuck at initial connection value
Fixed CC1 camera feed dropping during printing
Added password authentication with first-time setup via web UI
Added Spoolman integration: filament spool inventory with auto-deduction after each print
Added ELEGOO filament catalogue import from SpoolmanDB (97 filament types)
Added EAN barcode scan to auto-fill spool brand, material and colour
Docker image published to ghcr.io — two-command install, no git clone needed
Initial release
CC1 (Centauri Carbon 1) support via SDCP v3.0 over WebSocket
CC2 (Centauri Carbon 2) support via MQTT
Live status: idle, printing, warming up, paused, leveling, complete, cancelled, error
Temperature monitoring: nozzle, bed and chamber with live target values
Print progress: layer count, percentage, elapsed and remaining time
Filament tracking: live mm/g per print and cumulative history log
Camera feed proxied through Spooler (CC2)
Controls: pause, resume, stop, light toggle
Auto-discovery via UDP broadcast
PWA: installable on Android and iOS
HTTPS with self-signed cert on port 8443
